The file /home/hyoklee/cae_test_data/porotomo/dasv_native_PoroTomo_iDAS025_160318160317.h5 has a single root group (no subgroups) containing exactly 8 datasets:

| Dataset | Shape | Dtype |
|---------|-------|-------|
| /channel | (384,) | int32 |
| /crs | () (scalar) | uint8 |
| /das | (30000, 384) | float32 |
| /t | (30000,) | float64 |
| /trace | (30000,) | int64 |
| /x | (384,) | float32 |
| /y | (384,) | float32 |
| /z | (384,) | float32 |

Notes: /das is the main DAS strain-rate array (30,000 time samples × 384 channels). The x/y/z datasets give the 384 channel positions, channel holds channel indices, t holds the 30,000 sample times, trace holds trace identifiers, and crs is a scalar coordinate-reference-system flag.
